scene_prompt:
A 9:16 vertical photograph for a mobile ad for DoorDash: a bright, sun-drenched suburban American street on a clear summer afternoon, shot from a low angle looking up. A young woman with long curly dark hair blowing in the wind, wearing a soft pastel-yellow zip sweatshirt and matching shorts, strides confidently toward the camera past the glossy flank of a vivid orange car parked at the curb. She carries a plain, bright tomato-red (#FF3008) reusable tote bag, completely unmarked, overflowing with fresh groceries and a bundle of white lilies. Behind her, the edge of a pale stucco house with a terracotta roof and a young leafy tree. Open, cloudless sky fills the top of the frame; the bottom of the frame falls into the smooth cool shadow of the pavement and the car's lower body. Deep saturated cobalt-blue sky, hard direct sunlight, crisp shadows, punchy high-contrast colour with red, orange, yellow and blue as the dominant palette. Mood: joyful, energetic, everyday errands made effortless. Editorial lifestyle photography, 35mm film look, slight grain.

Composition (mandatory):
- Main subject between 30% and 65% of the image height, inside the central 70% of the width.
- Keep the band from 14% to 26% of the height calm and low in detail (sky, wall, soft
  shadow, plain surface): a logo will be placed there later.
- Keep the band from 68% to 85% of the height calm and darker or lighter than the rest:
  a headline will be placed there later.
- Backgrounds, light and texture may run to every edge.

Forbidden: any text, letters, numbers, logos, brand marks, signage, UI, watermarks,
screens showing content. No real or famous people. No other brands' products.

overlay_result.reason: Scene rejected after two attempts: the main subject overlaps the reserved headline band.
